goal: Pick a style direction (a / b / c) and get first reads on the room and the cast. See docs/art/visual-brief.md.

blocks.style_a: STYLE: soft vinyl designer-toy 3D render. Chunky, pillowy, inflated rounded shapes like collectible vinyl toys and Toca Boca-style 3D. Soft matte-satin plastic materials with a hint of subsurface scattering. Pastel-bright palette: warm cream, honey wood, sage green, teal, terracotta, sky blue, sunflower yellow. Shadows warm brown-violet, never pure black.
blocks.style_b: STYLE: wooden toy / Montessori 3D render. Everything looks hand-made from smooth turned beech wood, painted wood, felt and cotton fabric, like a high-end wooden dollhouse. Characters are peg-doll-like with lathe-turned bodies. Visible soft wood grain, slightly rounded edges on every block. Palette: natural honey and pale woods with muted primaries: sage green, teal, terracotta, sky blue, sunflower yellow. Shadows warm, never pure black.
blocks.style_c: STYLE: soft vinyl designer-toy characters inside a wooden dollhouse room. The room, furniture and props are hand-made wood, felt and fabric with soft visible wood grain (like a premium wooden dollhouse); the characters are chunky pillowy matte-satin vinyl toys (like collectible designer toys). Palette: warm natural woods with pastel-bright characters: cream, honey, sage green, teal, terracotta, sky blue, sunflower yellow. Shadows warm, never pure black.
blocks.room: SUBJECT: a cozy contemporary Arab family living room for a children's game, seen front-on like an open dollhouse (back wall fully visible, two side walls angled outward, floor in the foreground), camera slightly elevated, about 35mm, wide 16:9 framing. Late-afternoon sun streams through a large window covered by a wooden mashrabiya lattice screen, casting soft geometric light patterns across the floor and wall; teal curtains tied back on both sides. LAYOUT, follow the attached blocking diagram for where each object sits (the diagram is only a placement guide: do not draw its flat boxes, outlines or colours): left, a wooden bookshelf with chunky books on the top shelf beside a small Big Ben clock-tower model, a golden trophy and a colourful wooden abacus on the middle shelf, a potted plant and toys on the bottom shelf; on the back wall left of the window, a framed family photo; right of the window, a framed abstract calligraphy artwork made of swirling brush strokes (no legible letters), a round wall clock and a small tear-off wall calendar; right side, a low wooden cabinet with a small rounded TV and a toy-like game console on top; on the right side wall, the room's wooden door. Foreground floor: a large geometric-patterned rug in sage and terracotta; at front left a majlis corner of plump floor cushions, a small brass tray with a dallah coffee pot and tiny cups, a chubby cream-and-ginger cat napping on a cushion; at front centre a low wooden table holding a big toy letter cube and a toy camel; at front right a small wooden bench where the robot host will sit (leave it empty). Lived-in, tidy, tasteful cultural details, not a palace, no lanterns overload.
blocks.cast: SUBJECT: character lineup / model sheet of the four main characters of a children's game, standing side by side facing the viewer in a relaxed friendly pose, full body, on a plain soft warm-grey studio background with soft shadows. From left to right: (1) SARA, a girl of about 8, the tallest: dark brown moulded toy-hair in a high ponytail with a teal hair band, long-sleeved terracotta top, sage-green trousers, simple shoes, confident kind smile; modest clothing, no hijab. (2) YUSUF, a boy of about 5, about 80% of Sara's height and rounder: short black moulded hair with a small cowlick, sunflower-yellow t-shirt with a simple star, denim shorts, big chunky sneakers, cheeky grin. (3) NABEEH, a small round robot host about 60% of Sara's height: a big round silver-white head (about 45% of his height) on a round ball-shaped body so he could curl into a ball, a sky-blue baseball cap with a small yellow eight-point-star emblem, big round thick-framed glasses, a dark screen-like face plate showing simple glowing friendly eyes and mouth, a small 3x3 pastel keypad panel on his chest, short stubby arms with white mitten hands, short legs with blue-and-white sneakers, holding a small red book. (4) the CAT, a small chubby cream-and-ginger cat sitting, round head, tiny ears, long curled tail. Characters are Arab family members, warm brown skin tones for the kids.
blocks.constraints: CONSTRAINTS: every shape must be simple and buildable from rounded primitives (spheres, capsules, rounded boxes, cylinders, tori, bevelled blocks): chunky proportions, big heads, stub limbs, mitten or ball hands, no fine sculpted detail, no wrinkles, no hair strands, no cloth folds. Faces are flat graphic shapes printed or painted on the surface (simple eyes, brows, small mouth, no sculpted noses). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Clean, appealing, high-quality 3D render, soft global illumination, gentle ambient occlusion, shallow depth of field kept minimal so everything reads clearly.
